description: Rename or re-describe one of the caller's shelves. Fields the input omits are left as they are.

main.description: Load the shelf, apply the supplied fields, save. Answers NotFound when the shelf does not exist.

shelf.description: AT-URI of the shelf record to update.

name.description: New shelf name. Omit to keep the current one.

description.description: New description. Omit to keep the current one; an empty string clears it.

uri.description: AT-URI of the updated shelf record.

updated.description: True when a field was changed, false when the input carried none.
